title: Dividend Income Equity Analysis
description: Schema 3.0 / rubric 2: definite decisions, ordered evidence recovery, numeric provisional bounds and Chinese single-file HTML. Full Analysis retains six main sections and an optional audit appendix. Explicit dispatch preserves 2.3/2.4/2.5 behavior without retroactive retrieval requirements or relabeling discretionary scores. Safety Review remains cash/capital-only, without new valuation, scoring or trading instructions.

input_detail.description: Specific operating, cash, policy or share input assessed, not a generic request for more evidence.

source_refs.description: Exact entries from the report's sources array. Empty is allowed only for missing evidence.

resolution_source.description: Disclosure or record needed to resolve a gap; null when supported.

consequence.description: Effect on normalization or the investment action.

sourceRefs.description: Exact entries from the report's sources array, not invented citation identifiers.

scoreRange.description: Rubric bounds using current evidence and caps, not a statistical confidence interval or an imputed score.

cash_unit_scale.description: Currency units per reported cash unit, e.g. 1000000 for millions.

share_unit_scale.description: Actual shares per reported share-count unit.

amount.description: Signed bridge from the forecast reference metric to the issuer's stated payout base.

valuation_unit_scale.description: Currency units per quoted price/value unit: 1 for GBP, 0.01 for GBp. Buy-zone and growth per-share cash/value numbers use this same unit.

shares_per_quoted_security.description: Underlying dividend-entitled shares per quoted share/ADR; explicitly use 1 for an ordinary share.

risk_free_rate.description: Dated risk-free anchor after the disclosed tax/currency treatment, in decimals.

net_dps.description: Full-period net DPS per quoted security, already tax/fee/FX/unit adjusted. Multiply by cash_fraction only in PV.

cash_fraction.description: Documented remaining cash fraction of that fiscal year's dividend; 1 for a full year.

investor_cash_deductions.description: Full-period fees per quoted security in whole valuation-currency units, before applying cash_fraction.

terminal_net_dps.description: First full-year recurring net DPS after the explicit/transition horizon.

terminal_growth_cap.description: Conservative modeling cap, not a market fact. Must also respect the evidenced long-run nominal bound.

after_cost_advantage.description: Cumulative same-horizon return advantage after one-off and recurring costs; decimal form.

portfolioContext.description: Provenance and applicability of a previously established income target; does not require uploading holdings for a percentage-yield screen.

target_net_yield.description: Decimal form. Null when no applicable screening target is available.

hard_minimum_exception_allowed.description: True only when the user explicitly permits exceptions.

actual_distribution_capacity.description: Actual all-in FCF after remaining mandatory owner uses, excluding excess cash and financing/disposal proceeds.

fcf_dividend_coverage.description: Recurring FAD / relevant cash dividends paid; null for unavailable or zero-denominator periods.

nonrecurring_operating_cash_inflow.description: Evidenced temporary operating inflow excluded from recurring owner cash. Never financing or disposal proceeds.

fcf_or_distributable_cash.description: Legacy field retained: Recurring Owner FCF or the selected pre-remaining-deductions sector proxy.

growth_value_change.description: Dated cash-flow PV effect; transient effects must not change terminal growth or normalized N.

policy_implied_dividend.description: Policy-implied gross cash-equivalent entitlement, prior to scrip election and modeled funding adjustment.

dividend_entitlement.description: Modeled gross cash-equivalent entitlement before issuer scrip elections; not actual cash cost.

settlement_cash_adjustment.description: Additional documented issuer settlement cash; do not add withholding already inside gross cash entitlement.

investor_cash_dps.description: Cash per starting underlying share after dated stock entitlements; only a reconciled event ledger may differ from issuer DPS.

dividend_entitlement.description: Modeled gross cash-equivalent entitlement before issuer scrip elections; not actual cash cost.

settlement_cash_adjustment.description: Additional documented issuer settlement cash; do not add withholding already inside gross cash entitlement.

cash_election_confirmed.description: Event-specific cash access/election, including the investor's channel; false for a mandatory stock-only event.

noncash_value.description: Disclosure-only value of noncash shares; never a cash-DPS input.

observations.description: Complete series used for a claimed median; not a selected favorable subsample.

economic_gross_dps_delta.description: Incremental operating cash/payout effect from revenue-cost-debt FX exposure, in source-currency DPS; zero if already in the runway.

hedge_cash_adjustment.description: Incremental net hedge cash per quoted security in whole valuation currency, not another FX multiplier.

material_exposure.description: Null when materiality cannot be established; unknown is not false.

capital_headroom.description: Signed surplus relative to the applicable documented capital/covenant minimum, not an uninterpreted solvency or CET1 ratio.

full_cash_entitlement.description: Matching-period all-cash-equivalent entitlement before optional scrip retention; excludes mandatory stock-only awards.

five_year_dividend_history.description: Up to five or more fiscal years; use all available history for newly listed issuers.

forward_net_dps.description: Evidenced full-year recurring net cash per quoted security in the valuation price unit.

cash_election_available.description: Cash option for the described scheme. No does not erase separately audited cash-dividend events. Mixed schedules use cash_components_only and event-level records; ordinary cash without an election scheme may use Not Applicable.

three_year_fundamental_forecast.description: Exactly one Bear/Base/Bull row for each of years 1-3. Preserve this legacy field name.

forecast_extension.description: One row per scenario in years 4-5. Unavailable estimates use null cash values, not_estimable, and a specific reason.

normalization_cash_deductions.description: Normalized annual investor fees per quoted security, in whole valuation-currency units.

too_expensive_zone.description: Compatibility key: below required cash yield; not intrinsic overvaluation.

fair_value_zone.description: Compatibility key: normalized income is within the required range.

accumulation_zone.description: Compatibility key: normalized income meets the high-end requirement; not an automatic add action.

strong_buy_zone.description: Compatibility key: Bear income meets the high-end requirement; action_assessment independently governs Strong Buy eligibility.

years_from_valuation.description: Payment time from valuation date; absent means sequential end-year payments. Residual is recovered at the final modeled cash date.
